title: IIT-Emergence: IIT with the exclusion postulate relaxed

statements.text: Safron proposes factoring IIT into IIT-Consciousness, the original theory, and IIT-Emergence, a version with the exclusion axiom relaxed that analyzes irreducible cause-effect power without concern for conscious status. It would fit FEP-AI better, serve as a general model of emergent causation, and sidestep quasi-panpsychism.

sources.quote: IIT-Emergence: an alternative version of the theory where the exclusion axiom is relaxed.

This broader version of IIT could also sidestep issues such as quasi-panpsychism, as integrated information would not necessarily represent a sufficient condition for generating conscious experiences.
